title: Mondo TLR Endurance Tire
notes: Official US page read 2026-11-01: US$89.99; use 'All-road endurance'; GRIPTON T2/T5 dual compound with a T5 shoulder; 120 TPI 3-ply casing with puncture-resistant strips and reinforced sidewalls, tubeless; approximate weights 700x28c 310 g, 700x32c 330 g, 700x35c 360 g. Claims 11% less rolling resistance than the previous class-leading endurance tire. No hookless statement or maximum pressure.
